description.value: The Lodge is the central accommodation building at Manning Park Resort, a major year-round destination in the Cascade Mountains drawing over one million visitors annually. It sits within a full-service resort offering cabins, chalets, camping, and the Pinewoods Restaurant serving comfort food in a mountain setting. For touring cyclists, it represents one of the few substantial service stops along Highway 3 through Manning Provincial Park.
